name: Range mode - failed auction to POC
thesis: In a balanced open, pokes beyond the value-area edge that fail (trapped traders) snap back to the POC - high WR, small target.
rules: Volume profile of params.profile_window (1m bars, volume spread per tick - approximation until trades data), value area 70%. Poke = bar trades poke_ticks+ beyond VAH/VAL; if a bar closes back inside within reclaim_bars (poke bar = 1st), fade at next bar open. Stop = poke extreme + 2 ticks, target = POC, skip if reward < min_rr x risk. No reclaim in time = that side dead for the day. Entries from profile end to 11:30, flat 12:00, max 2/day. Code: tools/backtest/setups/range_mode.py.

target.note: params.target_at: POC of the profile window
